limitations: This is a 120-text pilot over two source messages and four close/wide banks, not the final nine-source distribution.
Every October reference exceeds at least one current camera budget, so zero exact normalized-reference matches can be the correct result rather than a failure to follow the reference-first policy.
Education and Gaming have no October reference; their required category extensions should be less similar than Office, Home, Café, and Creative Studio candidates.
Close-up profiles necessarily delete room, object, and background details and are not directly comparable with wide prompts.

Raw clause-level C-Tech change lists and model-authored proximity explanations were not reliable enough for review. The deterministic finalizer preserves lineage, relationship and score, but replaces both fields with high-level relationship summaries; every raw response remains preserved.

All four first draws under the final prompt failed at least one deterministic or semantic check and were replaced without changing the prompt; several banks required multiple bounded draws. The report describes accepted outputs, not first-draw reliability.
Embedding and TF-IDF similarity measure text proximity, not downstream image quality. No V4.1 image generation is authorized by this report.
The V4 comparison uses the final accepted prompts for the same four source/camera cases; it is descriptive because V4.1 also changes ordering and reference-lineage fields.
